mapper.insert: INSERT INTO webhook_endpoints ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, created_by_api_key_uuid, url, name, description, enabled_events, signing_secret, status, disabled_reason, consecutive_failures, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.CreatedByAPIKeyUUID}, #{params.URL,sensitive=true}, #{params.Name}, #{params.Description}, CAST(#{params.EnabledEvents} AS jsonb), #{params.SigningSecret,sensitive=true}, #{params.Status}, #{params.DisabledReason,sensitive=true}, #{params.ConsecutiveFailures}, #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM webhook_endpoints WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC, uuid DESC
mapper.update:
UPDATE webhook_endpoints
url = #{params.URL,sensitive=true}, name = #{params.Name}, description = #{params.Description}, enabled_events = CAST(#{params.EnabledEvents} AS jsonb),
status = #{params.Status}, disabled_reason = CASE WHEN #{params.Status} = 'enabled' THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(disabled_reason, 'manual') END, failure_started_at = CASE WHEN #{params.Status} = 'enabled' THEN NULL ELSE failure_started_at END, consecutive_failures = CASE WHEN #{params.Status} = 'enabled' THEN 0 ELSE consecutive_failures END,
updated_at = #{params.UpdatedAt}
WHERE workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{params.ExternalID} AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING
mapper.select: SELECT uuid FROM webhook_endpoints WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'enabled' AND jsonb_exists(enabled_events, #{eventType}) ORDER BY created_at ASC, uuid ASC
SELECT url, signing_secret, status FROM webhook_endpoints WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND uuid = #{endpointUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE webhook_endpoints SET consecutive_failures = 0, failure_started_at = NULL, disabled_reason = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE uuid = #{endpointUUID} AND workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'enabled'

WITH locked_endpoint AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT uuid, failure_started_at FROM webhook_endpoints WHERE uuid = #{params.EndpointUUID} AND workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'enabled' FOR UPDATE ), failure_state AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT uuid, COALESCE(failure_started_at, clock_timestamp()) AS started_at, (#{params.ImmediateDisable} OR ( failure_started_at IS NOT NULL AND clock_timestamp() >= failure_started_at + #{params.DisableAfterMicroseconds} * INTERVAL '1 microsecond' )) AS disable FROM locked_endpoint ) UPDATE webhook_endpoints e SET consecutive_failures = consecutive_failures + 1, failure_started_at = f.started_at, status = CASE WHEN f.disable THEN 'disabled' ELSE e.status END, disabled_reason = CASE WHEN #{params.ImmediateDisable} THEN #{params.Reason,sensitive=true} WHEN f.disable THEN 'auto-disabled after sustained delivery failures' ELSE e.disabled_reason END, updated_at = clock_timestamp() FROM failure_state f WHERE e.uuid = f.uuid AND e.workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} RETURNING e.status = 'disabled' AS disabled
